name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen's entry into the world of motorsport PR was somewhat accidental, stemming from his early career as a journalist covering rally racing in Finland. He quickly discovered a knack for crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations, transitioning from reporting on the action to shaping the public's perception of it. He thrives on the fast-paced nature of the sport and the challenge of maintaining a positive image for his clients, even amidst the inevitable controversies. 

Jari's approach is methodical and detail-oriented. He believes in thorough preparation, proactive communication, and building strong relationships with journalists. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to spin even the most unfavorable situations into opportunities. What sets Jari apart is his deep understanding of both the technical and human aspects of motorsport, allowing him to connect with audiences on multiple levels. He's a master of crafting the perfect narrative, ensuring that his client's story is always front and center.

He is a perfectionist, and expects those around him to put in the same effort that he does.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jari is a man of medium build with a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Finnish coffee available at all times.
